verdicts.reason: Confirmed V-P violation: holSemanticsScript.sml:87 defines is_term_valuation0 universally (∀v ty. type_ok tysig ty ⇒ ...), whereas HolSemantics.lean:45 uses an existential (∃ v ty, type_ok tysig ty → ...). Because type_ok holds for every Tyvar and fails for any Tyapp missing from tysig, Lean's definition is trivially true (e.g., with empty tysig and always-false mem) while HOL4's is false.
